description: The plot titled “Whisper fine-tunning, type = small” illustrates how WER changes over training epochs for four “small” configurations. The x-axis is labeled “epoch,” uses a linear scale, and runs from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at every 1 epoch. The y-axis is labeled “WER,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 25 to 42.5 with tick marks every 2.5 units. Four orange lines are shown with different markers and line styles: (1) “small AdaLoRA_int4” is a solid line with circle markers, decreasing steadily from about 35.6 at epoch 0 to about 30.5 at epoch 6, with intermediate values around 34.7 (epoch 1), 33.8 (epoch 2), 32.9 (epoch 3), 32.1 (epoch 4), and 31.3 (epoch 5). (2) “small AdaLoRA_int8” is a solid line with square markers, generally decreasing from about 30.0 at epoch 0 to about 25.0 at epoch 6, passing through about 29.8 (epoch 1), 28.6 (epoch 2), 28.1 (epoch 3), 27.3 (epoch 4), and 26.5 (epoch 5). (3) “small int4” is a dashed line with circle markers, rising from about 35.6 at epoch 0 to a peak near 42.2 at epoch 2, then declining to about 31.5 by epoch 6, with values around 40.1 (epoch 1), 38.7 (epoch 3), 36.3 (epoch 4), and 34.0 (epoch 5). (4) “small int8” is a dashed line with square markers, increasing from about 30.0 at epoch 0 to about 33.7 at epoch 2, then dropping to about 29.4 at epoch 3 and continuing downward to about 25.4 at epoch 5 before ending near 25.9 at epoch 6.
